pictures.scene: John Everett Millais, Victory O Lord! — Aaron and Hur holding up Moses' arms on the rock until the sun goes down, Moses and Aaron were among His priests, Samuel was among those who called on His name
pictures.name: pd_millais_priesters

pictures.scene: Paolo Veronese, Christ and the Centurion — the soldier down on his knees in the road and the Lord's hand lifted in answer, they called to the LORD and He answered
pictures.name: pd_veronese_aanriepen

pictures.scene: Piero della Francesca, The Baptism of Christ — the dove hanging in the opened sky over the Jordan while the words come down, they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them, O LORD our God You answered them
pictures.name: pd_piero_wolk

pictures.scene: Caravaggio, The Calling of Saint Matthew — the tax collector pointing at himself in the shaft of light as the call reaches him, You were a forgiving God to them
pictures.name: pd_caravaggio_vergeven

pictures.scene: Pieter Bruegel the Elder, The Tower of Babel — the unfinished tower still swarming with scaffolding and workmen before it is brought to nothing, yet an avenger of their misdeeds, exalt the LORD our God
pictures.name: pd_bruegel_wreker

pictures.scene: Caspar David Friedrich, Der Watzmann — the white peak standing far above the broken rocks and the haze, and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy
pictures.name: pd_friedrich_berg

lines.text: Moses and Aaron were among His priests;
Samuel was among those who called on His name.
They called to the LORD and He answered.
He spoke to them from the pillar of cloud;
they kept His decrees and the statutes He gave them.
O LORD our God, You answered them.
You were a forgiving God to them,
yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
and worship at His holy mountain,
for the LORD our God is holy.
